capabilities: List external links in the current note
Show which other notes link to a given external link
Display the list in a right side panel
extras: The README is only two sentences and gives no usage instructions or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian surfaces internal backlinks but offers no panel view of a note's external links or which notes share them.
summary: Side panel that lists all external links in the current note and shows which other notes link to the same link.
